sn36.6:1.1: Assutavā bhikkhave puthujjano sukham pi vedanaṃ vediyati dukkham pi vedanaṃ vediyati adukkhamasukham pi vedanaṃ vediyati || || 4
sn36.6:1.2: Sutavā bhikkhave ariyasāvako sukham pi vedanaṃ vediyati dukkham pi vedanaṃ vediyati adukkhamasukham pi vedanaṃ vediyati || 5
sn36.6:1.3: Tatra bhikkhave ko viseso ko adhippāyoso kim nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenāti || || 6
sn36.6:1.5: Assutavā bhikkhave puthujjano dukkhāya vedanāya puṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattālīkandati sammoham āpajjati ||
sn36.6:1.9: tam enam dutiyena sallena vijjheyyuṃ || evaṃ
sn36.6:1.10: hi so bhikkhave puriso dve salle vedanā vediyati || ||
sn36.6:1.11: Evam eva kho bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano dukkhāya vedanāya puṭṭho samāno socati kilamati paridevati urattāliṃ kandati sammoham āpajjati ||
sn36.6:1.14: tassāyeva kho pana dukkhāya vedanāya puṭṭho samāno paṭighavā hoti ||
sn36.6:1.15: tam enam dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighavantaṃ yo dukkhāya vedanāya patighānusayo so anuseti || ||
sn36.6:1.16: So dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno kāmasukham abhinandati ||
sn36.6:1.18: na hi bhikkhave pajānāti assutavā puthujjano aññatra kāmasukhā dukkhāya vedanāya nissaraṇaṃ ||
sn36.6:1.19: tassa kāmasukham abhinandato yo sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo so anuseti ||
sn36.6:1.20: so tāsaṃ vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtaṃ nappajānāti ||
sn36.6:1.21: tassa tāsam vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam appajānato yo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo so anuseti || ||
sn36.6:1.22: So sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati saññutto naṃ vediyati || dukkhaṃ
sn36.6:1.23: ce vedanaṃ vediyati saññutto naṃ vediyati || adukkhamasukhaṃ
sn36.6:1.24: ce vedanaṃ vediyati saññutto naṃ vediyati ||
sn36.6:1.25: ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave assutavā puthujjano saññutto jātiyā maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi saññutto dukkhasmāti vadāmi || || 9
sn36.6:2.1: Sutavā ca kho bhikkhave ariyasāvako dukkhāya vedanāya puṭṭho samāno na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattālīkandati na sammoham āpajjati ||
sn36.6:3.1: Seyyathāpi bhikkhave purisaṃ sallena vijjheyyuṃ || na
sn36.6:3.2: tam enaṃ dutiyena sallena anuvijjheyyuṃ || || Evaṃ hi
sn36.6:3.3: so bhikkhave puriso ekasallena vedanaṃ vediyati || ||
sn36.6:3.4: Evam eva kho bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno na socati na kilamati na paridevati na urattāḷīkandati na sammoham āpajjati ||
sn36.6:3.7: tassā yeva kho pana dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighavā na hoti ||
sn36.6:3.8: tam enam dukkhāya vedanāya apaṭighavantaṃ yo dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighanusayo so nānuseti || ||
sn36.6:3.9: So dukkhāya vedanāya phuṭṭho samāno kāmasukhaṃ nābhinandati ||
sn36.6:3.11: pajānāti bhikkhave sutavā ariyasāvako aññatra kāmasukhā dukkhāya vedanāya nissaraṇaṃ ||
sn36.6:3.12: tassa kāmasukhaṃ nābhinandato yo sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo so nānuseti || ||
sn36.6:3.13: So tāsaṃ vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam pajānāti ||
sn36.6:3.14: tassa tāsaṃ vedanānaṃ samudayañca atthagamañca assādañca ādīnavañca nissaraṇañca yathābhūtam pajānato yo adukkhamasukhāya vedanāya avijjānusayo so nānuseti || ||
sn36.6:3.15: So sukhaṃ ce vedanaṃ vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati || dukkham
sn36.6:3.16: ce vedanaṃ vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati || adukkhamasukhaṃ
sn36.6:3.17: ce vedanam vediyati visaññutto naṃ vediyati || ||
sn36.6:3.18: Ayaṃ vuccati bhikkhave ariyasāvako visaññuto jātiyā jarāya maraṇena sokehi paridevehi dukkhehi domanassehi upāyāsehi visaññutto dukkhasmā ti vadāmi || || 11
sn36.6:3.19: Ayaṃ kho bhikkhave viseso ayam adhippāyoso idaṃ nānākaraṇaṃ sutavato ariyasāvakassa assutavatā puthujjanenā ti || || 12
sn36.6:4.2: sukham pi dukkham pi bahussuto pi || ayaṃ
